required_changes: Preserve published v1 BrushDefinition/BrushProgram behavior and add the minimal explicit RB-V01 Vector brush version path (preferred: Pen/version 2) without canonical schema expansion.
Add canonical-expressible smoothing/streamline authoring/runtime mapping for RB-V01 while preserving v1 identity compatibility.
Encode pressure/thinning faithfully through the existing canonical PressureMapping curve rather than dropping influence strength during commit.

Implement a renderer-neutral common VectorStroke geometry generator owned by Axiom, with continuous filled variable-width geometry, fixed/versioned start/end taper, deterministic one-shot evaluation, and incremental stable-prefix/replaceable-tail output.
Use the same common vector geometry semantics for active preview and canonical replay/render.
Replace the Windows qualification path that converts raw pointer samples directly into fixed-radius Arc vector points with mapping from common Axiom vector preview geometry.
Extend the Arc preview payload only as narrowly as required to carry render-ready vector geometry; Arc must not own smoothing, pressure, width, taper or family semantics.
Render RB-V01 canonical geometry through Skia and render Arc preview through the independently owned Arc preview renderer/backend.
Implement Space dual-color diagnostic as a presentation-only override; move legacy preview-mirror toggle away from Space if retained.
Preserve CanonicalCommitted/CanonicalVisible handoff safety and add parity checks for geometry continuity.
Expose RB-V01 qualification controls for size, pressure/thinning and smoothing/streamline; taper remains fixed/versioned.
Materialize automated evidence, G5 vector workload metrics and an exact Windows qualification bundle.
